subject: Re: Request for penetration test deliverables and remediation summary
messages:
From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:42:11 -0500
Subject: Request: penetration test deliverables and remediation summary

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As discussed, Nimbus needs the following items from the recent third-party penetration test so our security review can proceed:

- Final pen test report (redacted if necessary for vendor PII)
- Scope & testing dates (tooling and IP ranges used)
- A reconciliation of findings with current remediation status (owner + completion date)
- Evidence artifacts for medium+ findings (screenshot/packet logs where possible)

We will need a cover email that we can share with our internal security committee and procurement. Timing: if you can provide the materials by COB Monday Nov 22 that keeps our renewal on schedule.

If any items contain customer data we understand redaction is required — let us know if you need an NDA or further routing details.

Best,
Sarah
Security Program Manager
Nimbus Health

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:08:03 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Request: penetration test deliverables and remediation summary

Folks — forwarding Nimbus' request. Can one of you own assembling the artifacts and a customer-facing cover note? Key asks: final report (redacted as needed), scope details, mitigation/owner/completion list, and any evidence we can reasonably share for medium+ findings.

Notes:
- Pen test vendor is RedProbe; report final version is on S3 but contains raw logs (sensitive).
- We should avoid sending raw packet captures without redaction.

Karthik — can you confirm where the canonical artifacts live and whether the remediation tracker is up to date? Monica / Evelyn, any security sign-off requirements before we send?

I plan to respond to Nimbus by EOD Mon (Nov 22) with a consolidated package or a timeline if we can't meet that date.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:17:44 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: penetration test deliverables and remediation summary

Marcus / team — taking ownership of artifact collection and the mitigation reconciliation. Quick status: 

1) Final report (RedProbe v1.2) — stored at https://s3.redwood.example.com/nimbus/pt-reports/20261115/report-v1.2.pdf. This PDF includes raw appendix with few vendor logs. I will create a redacted PDF (remove IPs and packet excerpts) for customer consumption.

2) Scope & tooling — in the report header (pages 2–3) and in the vendor's summary doc (vendor-scope-20261115.pdf). Will extract a one-page scope summary.

3) Mitigation tracker — current internal tracker is up to date for critical/medium findings. Export attached as mitigation-tracker-20261121.csv. Short summary: 2 critical (both remediated and verified), 7 medium (4 remediated, 3 in progress). Owners are included in the CSV.

4) Evidence artifacts — we can share redacted screenshots and sanitized logs for medium items; raw pcap files are restricted and require security approval. I list proposed shareables below:
  - medium-04-sql-injection-screenshot.png (redacted)
  - medium-07-auth-bypass-headers.txt (sanitized)
  - medium-02-session-cookie-sample.txt (redacted)

Security approvals needed: Monica, can you sign off on the redaction level for the PDF and confirm whether sanitized logs are acceptable? Also confirm whether an NDA is required before sharing the redacted report.

I will assemble a customer-facing ZIP with the redacted report and mitigation CSV by Monday morning if greenlit.

-Karthik
Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 08:05:12 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: penetration test deliverables and remediation summary

Thanks Karthik — this plan looks good. A few notes from security: 

- Redaction: remove internal IP ranges, vendor-identifying tokens, and any customer-identifiable strings. Redacted PDF + a short redaction log (one paragraph describing what was removed) is acceptable. No raw pcaps to external parties without a signed DPA/NDA and S-SHARE approval.
- Evidence: sanitized logs and screenshots are fine for medium findings. For any evidence that might include customer identifiers escalate to privacy for an extra review (we'll loop in Priyom if that occurs).
- Attestation timeline: if Karthik can provide the redacted bundle by Mon 11/22 10:00 AM, Security will review and sign off by 3 PM the same day. After sign-off Marcus can deliver to the customer.

Also: create a short mitigation summary that maps vendor finding IDs to our internal JIRA keys (SEC-145, SEC-146, SEC-149). That helps Nimbus track closure on their side.

Monica Patel
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test deliverables and remediation summary

Sarah —

Thanks again for the call and for outlining what Nimbus needs. Attached is a consolidated, customer-ready package: 

- nimbus_pt_report_v1.2-redacted.pdf (RedProbe final report, redacted per Security guidelines)
- mitigation-tracker-20261122.csv (row per finding, our owner, status, JIRA reference)
- evidence/ (zip of sanitized screenshots and text artifacts for medium findings) — note: raw pcaps are not included.

Highlights: 
- Critical findings: 2 — both remediated and verified (JIRA SEC-145, SEC-146).
- Medium findings: 7 — 4 remediated/verified, 3 in progress (see CSV for owners and ETA).

Security has reviewed and signed off on the redaction level. If Nimbus needs raw artifacts for legal/regulatory review we can provide them under a signed DPA/NDA and S-SHARE distribution; please advise if that's necessary.

Next steps: we can schedule a 30-minute technical walk-through with Karthik and our runtime team if your reviewers want deeper context on mitigations. Proposed times: Tue 11/23 10:00–10:30 AM ET or Wed 11/24 2:00–2:30 PM ET.

If this package covers your needs, let me know and I'll mark the renewal as cleared on our side.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimbus_pt_report_v1.2-redacted.pdf (PDF, 2.4 MB); mitigation-tracker-20261122.csv (CSV, 45 KB); evidence-mediums.zip (ZIP, 1.1 MB)
